sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Dileep Kumar Srivastava Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Manoj Bajaj,J.
Applicant has approached this Court through this application under Section 483 Code of Criminal Procedure for issuance of directions to the Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C. Kushinagar at Padarauna, to expedite and conclude the proceedings in Case No.4552 of 2020, titled State Vs.
Nuruddin and others, arising out of case crime no.43 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 326 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kotwali Padarauna, District Kushinagar in a stipulated period.
Concededly, the charge was framed on 20th April, 2024, in a case filed in February, 2020.
No exceptional ground is made out for issuing the directions for expeditious disposal of the trial.
The application fails and is hereby dismissed.
